title: Salesforce Knowledge Article
description: Schema for a Salesforce Knowledge article record.

Id.description: Salesforce record ID for the KnowledgeArticle

KnowledgeArticleId.description: The master article ID shared across all versions

UrlName.description: URL-friendly slug used in article URLs

Summary.description: Short summary of the article content

PublishStatus.description: Current publication status of the article

Language.description: Language code for the article (e.g., en_US, fr, de)

IsVisibleInApp.description: Whether the article is visible in the Salesforce app channel

IsVisibleInPkb.description: Whether the article is visible in the Public Knowledge Base channel

IsVisibleInCsp.description: Whether the article is visible in the Customer Portal channel

IsVisibleInPrm.description: Whether the article is visible in the Partner Portal channel

LastPublishedDate.description: Timestamp when the article was last published

CreatedDate.description: Timestamp when the article was created

LastModifiedDate.description: Timestamp when the article was last modified

CreatedById.description: Salesforce ID of the user who created the article

OwnerId.description: Salesforce ID of the article owner
